SLA CREDIT MEMORANDUM — Master Services Agreement with Jaffle Werke (CLI-0042), contract CON-0042-01. Effective 2025-02-05.~~NL~~Pursuant to the credit clause of the MSA, Jaffle Logistics acknowledges that the January 14-16 winter storm at the Paris hub caused on-time performance to fall below the contracted target. Root event documented under incident INC-2025-00417. Jaffle Logistics will apply a credit of 1.0% of January spend per full percentage point below target, capped at 10%. This memorandum does not otherwise modify the MSA.
